json.title: FP&A Analyst | Commodities & Global Markets
json.descriptionHtml:
Supporting the Macquarie Commodities and Global Markets division, our Financial Planning and Analysis team is responsible for presenting on the performance of the business with key responsibilities including analysing, reviewing, and discussing information with relevant stakeholders.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

In this role, you will build and maintain strong relationships across Commodities and Global Markets and wider support functions to provide decision support and advice to stakeholders. You will support a division within the group and be responsible for the monthly reporting and presentation of financials and key metrics. Furthermore, you will work closely with the wider team on group wide deliverables including; forecasting, stress testing, half and year end deliverables as well as other strategic initiatives. This role provides an opportunity to join a high performing team, learn about and grow with the group.

What You Offer

  • 1-3 years of experience in an analytical role within a complex and fast-paced environment balancing competing priorities
  • Strong Excel skills and experience with a BI tool (Power BI, AI driven dashboard etc.) is highly regarded
  • CA/CPA qualification preferred but not essential
  • Exposure to or genuine interest in applying AI tools within a finance context

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Benefits

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on employment type, include:

  • 1 wellbeing leave day per year
  • Up to 5 additional service bonus leave days per year
  • Up to 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of transition leave upon return to work, and 6 weeks’ paid leave for non-primary caregivers
  • 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
  • Up to 12 months’ gender affirmation leave, including 6 weeks’ paid leave
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing benefits including skin and health checks, and flu vaccinations
  • Access to a wide range of salary packaging options
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
  • Reimbursement for work from home equipment

About Commodities and Global Markets

Commodities and Global Markets is a global business offering capital and financing, risk management, market access, physical execution and logistics solutions to its diverse client base across Commodities, Financial Markets and Asset Finance.

Inclusion at Macquarie

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.

We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

json.title: Analyst, Global Investment Banking Industrials & Financial Sponsors
json.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

RBC Capital Markets Industrials & Financial Sponsors Investment Banking team is looking for an Analyst for our Sydney office. This is a coverage role where you will gain experience working with ASX listed and private equity clients across a range of sub-sectors including healthcare, consumer retail and general industrials. The candidate will have the opportunity to learn technical and soft skills as part of an established and growing team.

The wide range of the industries we cover provides an exceptional opportunity to learn as a generalist and then specialize as you progress your career with RBC Capital Markets. In the role, you will work with Private Equity and Corporate clients, as well as relevant internal product banking teams (LevFin, ECM, Corporate Banking, DCM and Risk Solutions).

What will you do?

  • Transaction execution and new business development
  • Preparing financial models, conducting research and analysing data to assist senior team members to advise clients
  • Analytical, due diligence and transactional support on transactions and business development
  • Work with the team in the development of pitch books and related client materials
  • Review and comply with Firm Policies applicable to your business activities
  • Proactively identify and escalate operational risk loss events, control deficiencies and risks to your line manager and the relevant risk and control functions promptly
  • Begin gaining skills to develop relationships with peers / juniors at clients, begin understanding how to develop business opportunities
  • Other such duties, responsibilities and authority as may be reasonably required, consistent with your background, experience and prior business activity

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

  • Minimum 1 year of relevant professional experience, preferably in Investment Banking, management consulting, law, Big 4 accounting (modeling/valuations, FDD, M&A)
  • Bachelor’s degree required; commerce/law preferred. Other degrees also of interest if relevant to our coverage universe, but strong foundations in corporate finance are essential
  • Knowledge of and willingness to learn about all investment banking products including M&A, equity, debt, and convertible securities
  • Outstanding quantitative and qualitative analytical skills; strong knowledge of finance and accounting
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to multi-task, manage conflicting priorities and prioritise deliverables
  • Team player mentality with the ability to work independently
  • Strong written and oral communication skills; excellent interpersonal skills with ability to create and maintain relationships at all levels of the organisation
  • Must maintain high standards of professional and ethical conduct

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best - progressive thinking to keep growing and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

  • Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
  • Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive and high-performing team
  • A world-class training program in financial services
  • Ability to make a difference and lasting impact.

RBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability or any other legally-protected factors.

RBC Group only pay fees to agencies where they have entered into a prior agreement to do so and in any event do not pay fees related to unsolicited resumés. Please contact the Recruitment function for additional details.

json.title: Fresher Data Analys (Entry / Junior Level)
json.descriptionHtml:
📈 We’re Hiring: Fresher Data Analyst

🔬 Position: Fresher Data Analyst

💼 Employment Type: Full-Time

We’re looking for a curious, analytical, and detail-focused Fresher Data Analyst to help transform raw data into useful insights and support smarter business decisions. This role is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, discovering patterns, and learning how data can solve real-world problems.

🧮 Key Responsibilities
  • Collect, organize, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Clean and validate datasets to maintain accuracy and consistency.
  • Prepare reports, dashboards, and visualizations for internal teams.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within business data.
  • Support recurring reporting and data analysis activities.
  • Assist teams with data-related questions and analytical requests.
  • Translate findings into clear summaries and actionable insights.
  • Help investigate data discrepancies and resolve quality issues.
  • Maintain documentation for reports, datasets, and analytical processes.
  • Learn and apply new analytical tools, techniques, and best practices.
🧩 What We’re Looking For
  • Basic understanding of data analysis, statistics, and business metrics.
  • Familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets, or similar spreadsheet tools.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or other visualization tools is a plus.
  • Basic knowledge of Python, R, or another programming language is beneficial.
  • Strong numerical reasoning and attention to detail.
  • Ability to identify patterns and explain findings clearly.
  • Good communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Curious mindset with enthusiasm for learning and working with data.
🌟 What We Offer
  • 📊 Hands-on experience working with real-world datasets.
  • 🧠 Mentorship and guidance from experienced analysts.
  • 📚 Training opportunities to strengthen technical and analytical skills.
  • 🛠️ Exposure to modern data and business intelligence tools.
  • 💡 Opportunities to contribute insights that support real business decisions.
  • 🤝 A collaborative environment where questions and ideas are welcomed.
  • 🌱 Clear opportunities for professional and technical growth.
  • 🎁 Competitive compensation and benefits package.

json.title: Risk Support Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
Brief Description

The Role

Line 1 Risk for Claims & Assessing enables effective risk management by guiding, supporting, and facilitating teams within the division in their ownership and management of operational incidents and risks. You will ensure consistent application of risk frameworks, accurate data capture, and continuous improvement, empowering divisional teams to manage their risk landscape effectively. This role will have a particular focus on Operational Resilience, embedding management of Models, Information security, Business Continuity and Suppliers Performance.

Position Accountabilities

  • Identify and escalate gaps in risk management processes, controls, or documentation within Claims & Assessing, recommending improvements.
  • Support the delivery of training and capability building initiatives related to risk management for divisional teams.
  • Guide Claims & Assessing teams in identifying potential incidents from complaints and review findings, and provide oversight for thorough incident investigations, ensuring accurate documentation in Nlighten (Risk Management System).
  • Stay up to date with changing cybersecurity trends and all applicable legislative requirements.
  • Facilitate incident and issue resolution and corrective actions within the division, liaising with Line 2 Compliance as needed, and ensuring clear ownership and accountability for all divisional issues.
  • Assure completeness and accuracy of all incident and issue data in Nlighten for Claims & Assessing, upholding data integrity and maintaining confidentiality of sensitive information.
  • Support the review of complaints handling effectiveness within the division to identify systemic issues and areas for improvement.
  • Guide and support divisional teams in conducting effective root cause analysis for incidents and issues and provide advice on effective control design to mitigate identified risks.
  • Facilitate linking divisional issues to related risks in Nlighten to enhance understanding of underlying causes, and guide ad-hoc risk assessments for specific projects or activities within Claims & Assessing.
  • Proactively identify patterns, themes, and insights from divisional incidents and issues through thematic reviews and analysis, ensuring data quality for consistent reporting.
  • Facilitate reporting to key decision-making forums, such as the Divisional Risk Forum, EXCO, and the Board.

Qualifications

What experience you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, Law, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., risk management, compliance) are desirable.

Skills & Experience

  • 1-3 years of experience in a risk, compliance, audit, or operational role, preferably within a

financial services or regulated environment.

Location : Sydney

json.descriptionHtml:
• Early Career and Graduates from quants disciplines considered
  • Work alongside leading quantitative specialists
  • Delivery of advanced statistical models that have global impact
  • Central offices, Hybrid Work and Competitive Remuneration

See Yourself in Our Team

Within the Capital & Provisioning Modelling Crew, you'll work alongside experienced statisticians, mathematicians, quantitative analysts and risk professionals to develop sophisticated statistical models that help the Group better understand and manage millions of customer portfolios.

We partner across disciplines to deliver outcomes in a highly regulated environment where governance requirements influence modelling approaches. We're responsible for developing, monitoring and validating the models used across CommBank, Bankwest and ASB, helping to protect our customers, strengthen the bank and enable sustainable growth.

We're a collaborative team where you'll learn from world-class specialists, solve complex challenges, influence strategic decisions, and use data, insights and innovation to make a meaningful impact.

Your Impact & Contribution

As an Analyst in Retail Models, you'll apply the mathematics, statistics and quantitative reasoning you've studied at university to solve complex, large-scale problems with real-world impact. Working alongside experienced quantitative specialists, you'll contribute to predictive analytics, portfolio performance and decision science, while building deep expertise in credit risk modelling, regulatory capital and provisioning frameworks.

This opportunity focuses on statistical modelling and quantitative problem-solving rather than reporting and dashboard development. You'll build highly transferable skills across quantitative modelling, data science, analytics and risk, creating strong foundations for a long-term career in quantitative disciplines.

In this role, you may expect to:

  • Support the development of sophisticated statistical models used across CommBank, Bankwest and ASB
  • Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends and insights
  • Apply statistical techniques to solve quantitative business problems
  • Support the development and enhancement of predictive models
  • Use Python, R and SQL to manipulate and analyse data
  • Contribute to model monitoring, validation and performance assessment
  • Document analytical findings and communicate insights clearly
  • Collaborate with quantitative analysts, statisticians and risk specialists
  • Build expertise in modelling, analytics and decision science

This opportunity provides the chance to develop deep quantitative capability, working alongside experienced practitioners who value technical excellence and are committed to helping you build highly transferable skills across analytics, modelling and data science.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Whether your passion is mathematics, statistics, econometrics, modelling or quantitative analysis, this role offers a strong foundation for a successful analytical career. We're particularly interested in graduates from Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Physics, Engineering and other highly quantitative disciplines. Subjects that may be particularly relevant include Probability Theory, Statistical Modelling, Mathematical Statistics, Econometrics, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, Optimisation, Calculus and Linear Algebra.

You'll be well placed for success with:

  • A strong academic record in a highly quantitative discipline
  • Strong foundations in mathematics, probability and statistics
  • Demonstrably high analytical thinking and problem-solving capability
  • Exposure to Python, R, SQL or similar analytical programming languages
  • Curiosity, learning agility and a detail-oriented mindset
  • The ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Academic excellence in quantitative subjects will be highly regarded

We're looking for people who are curious, mathematically minded and excited to learn. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Working With Us

At CommBank, we're committed to building a diverse, inclusive and flexible workplace where everyone can thrive.

We know talent comes from many different backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

Advertising End Date: 28/08/2026

json.title: ESG Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Purpose Bureau is a high-growth ESG data and technology business helping organisations better understand, measure, and manage sustainability-related risks and performance across their supply chains. We work at the intersection of data, research, and ESG, supporting clients with high-quality insights in a rapidly evolving space. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing business where you can learn from senior team members, build meaningful expertise, and develop your career in an area of increasing importance to businesses and supply chains.


About the Role

We're looking for an ESG Analyst with a sharp eye for detail, strong quality assurance instincts, and a genuine interest in sustainability. This role is ideal for someone with 1–2 years of experience in a data analyst, data operations, or similar hands-on data role, who enjoys identifying inconsistencies, working through ambiguity, and improving data quality. Beyond technical accuracy, we need someone who takes ownership of problems rather than waiting to be told what to do — someone who spots issues before they escalate, proposes fixes rather than just flagging faults, and treats process gaps as things to solve, not just work around. You do not need to be an ESG expert from day one. What matters most is strong analytical ability, excellent attention to detail, comfort working with data, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the willingness to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment.


Responsibilities

  • Verify supplier data, including confirming legal entity matches, industry classifications, and corporate group structures using databases, research tools, and structured workflows.
  • Conduct first-pass QA review of emissions data, checking submissions against expected ranges and identifying anomalies such as unusual year-on-year movements, high or low intensity outliers, and significant variance from sector benchmarks.
  • Perform initial QA checks on ESG ratings outputs across climate and social risk, escalating anomalies or exceptions to senior team members for review and sign-off — with a clear rationale and, where possible, a recommended resolution.
  • Cleanse, prepare, and standardise client-provided spend data for processing, including formatting, deduplication, and country alignment.
  • Coordinate regular data processing cycles and respond to ad hoc client requests in line with delivery timelines, flagging risks to those timelines early rather than after the fact.
  • Clearly document findings, data issues, and recommended next steps for review by senior team members.
  • Proactively identify recurring data issues, workflow inefficiencies, or process gaps and raise practical improvement ideas, not just symptoms.
  • Support the ongoing improvement of internal processes, workflows, and quality controls as the business continues to grow.


Qualifications

1–2 years' experience in a data analyst, data operations, or similar hands-on data role.


Required Skills

  • Advanced Excel capability, including data manipulation, cleansing, and review.
  • Experience with Power Query, or a demonstrated ability to learn new tools quickly.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a strong track record of identifying data issues and inconsistencies.
  • Comfortable using technology and automation tools to support research, data verification, and quality review, while applying critical thinking and sound judgement to maintain output quality.
  • Strong problem-solving skills — able to diagnose root causes, not just report symptoms, and recommend practical fixes.
  • Proactive mindset — takes initiative to flag risks, surface improvement opportunities, and act ahead of issues rather than waiting for direction.
  • Able to work quickly, stay organised, and maintain accuracy under time pressure.
  • Comfortable making reasonable judgement calls where information is incomplete or unclear.
  • Strong written communication skills, especially in documenting findings and escalating issues clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new systems, workflows, and domain knowledge in a changing environment.
  • Reliable, proactive, and accountable in managing tasks through to completion.


Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with ESG, sustainability, or supply chain concepts.
  • Exposure to entity matching, data cleansing, or similar data quality-focused work.
  • Experience in QA processes, exception handling, or structured research workflows.


Pay range and compensation package

  • Annual: $80,000.00 to $100,000.00 dependent on experience


Equal Opportunity Statement

Purpose Bureau is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other characteristic protected by law.

json.title: Quantitative Analyst, Retail Models
json.descriptionHtml:
• Early Career and Graduates from quants disciplines considered
  • Work alongside leading quantitative specialists
  • Delivery of advanced statistical models that have global impact
  • Central offices, Hybrid Work and Competitive Remuneration

See Yourself in Our Team

Within the Capital & Provisioning Modelling Crew, you'll work alongside experienced statisticians, mathematicians, quantitative analysts and risk professionals to develop sophisticated statistical models that help the Group better understand and manage millions of customer portfolios.

We partner across disciplines to deliver outcomes in a highly regulated environment where governance requirements influence modelling approaches. We're responsible for developing, monitoring and validating the models used across CommBank, Bankwest and ASB, helping to protect our customers, strengthen the bank and enable sustainable growth.

We're a collaborative team where you'll learn from world-class specialists, solve complex challenges, influence strategic decisions, and use data, insights and innovation to make a meaningful impact.

Your Impact & Contribution

As an Analyst in Retail Models, you'll apply the mathematics, statistics and quantitative reasoning you've studied at university to solve complex, large-scale problems with real-world impact. Working alongside experienced quantitative specialists, you'll contribute to predictive analytics, portfolio performance and decision science, while building deep expertise in credit risk modelling, regulatory capital and provisioning frameworks.

This opportunity focuses on statistical modelling and quantitative problem-solving rather than reporting and dashboard development. You'll build highly transferable skills across quantitative modelling, data science, analytics and risk, creating strong foundations for a long-term career in quantitative disciplines.

In this role, you may expect to:

  • Support the development of sophisticated statistical models used across CommBank, Bankwest and ASB
  • Analyse large and complex datasets to identify trends and insights
  • Apply statistical techniques to solve quantitative business problems
  • Support the development and enhancement of predictive models
  • Use Python, R and SQL to manipulate and analyse data
  • Contribute to model monitoring, validation and performance assessment
  • Document analytical findings and communicate insights clearly
  • Collaborate with quantitative analysts, statisticians and risk specialists
  • Build expertise in modelling, analytics and decision science

This opportunity provides the chance to develop deep quantitative capability, working alongside experienced practitioners who value technical excellence and are committed to helping you build highly transferable skills across analytics, modelling and data science.

What You'll Need To Succeed

Whether your passion is mathematics, statistics, econometrics, modelling or quantitative analysis, this role offers a strong foundation for a successful analytical career. We're particularly interested in graduates from Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Physics, Engineering and other highly quantitative disciplines. Subjects that may be particularly relevant include Probability Theory, Statistical Modelling, Mathematical Statistics, Econometrics, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, Optimisation, Calculus and Linear Algebra.

You'll be well placed for success with:

  • A strong academic record in a highly quantitative discipline
  • Strong foundations in mathematics, probability and statistics
  • Demonstrably high analytical thinking and problem-solving capability
  • Exposure to Python, R, SQL or similar analytical programming languages
  • Curiosity, learning agility and a detail-oriented mindset
  • The ability to communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Academic excellence in quantitative subjects will be highly regarded

We're looking for people who are curious, mathematically minded and excited to learn. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Working With Us

At CommBank, we're committed to building a diverse, inclusive and flexible workplace where everyone can thrive.

We know talent comes from many different backgrounds. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

Advertising End Date: 28/08/2026

json.descriptionHtml:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

At Circana, we are fuelled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We have a global commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion as we believe in the undeniable strength that diversity brings to our business, employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together.

Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

So, why Circana?

We’re progressive, inclusive and people focused. We seek to create a down-to-earth culture which balances work and home life and enables our team to be the best that it can be. Our people are important to us, and we offer a number of fantastic benefits including;

  • Flexible and hybrid working
  • Up to 5 weeks annual leave and holiday buy back scheme
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • Birthday leave
  • Summer half days
  • Circana “Me” Days (4 per year!)
  • Cultural swap days

What will you be doing?

You’ll play a key role in helping clients optimise their marketing strategies through advanced analytical solutions. You’ll translate complex data into actionable insights, collaborate with internal modelling teams, and build strong relationships with stakeholders to deliver impactful outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end analysis projects, ensuring timely delivery of actionable insights aligned with client needs and Circana’s standards
  • Translate client objectives into analytical requirements and study designs, collaborating closely with our internal modelling team
  • Gather and validate data from clients and internal teams to support robust analysis
  • Interpret modelling outcomes and deliver clear, business-relevant insights
  • Assist in developing client reports and visual presentations, including charting and storytelling
  • Respond to client queries and support proposal development alongside senior team members
  • Recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and quality
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships to drive satisfaction and sustainable revenue

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, statistics, psychology, economics or a related field preferred
  • 1–2 years’ experience as an Analyst, ideally within the market research industry
  • A strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret complex data and extract meaningful insights
  • Excellent problem‑solving skills with attention to detail, including creative and innovative thinking
  • Clear and concise communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with a talent for creating compelling visualisations and presentations
  • Exposure to survey programming software (e.g. Qualtrics), with experience in Q, R or Python highly regarded
  • A highly accountable and results‑oriented approach, demonstrating initiative and a proactive mindset
  • A natural ability to build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders

Circana Behaviours

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviours sit at the core of our organisation. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviours throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices
  • Centre on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect and integrity
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone

Ready to make an impact?

If you're passionate about data, thrive in a collaborative environment, and want to be part of a company that values your growth—we’d love to hear from you!

Apply now and let’s build something great together.

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice). Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

json.title: Strategy Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
See yourself being part of a large, transformational change? This could be the role for you!

At Iress, we make things happen

We believe technology should help people perform better every day. Since our beginning in 1993, people across financial services have trusted us to take their performance to the next level. More than 10,000 businesses and 500,000 people use our software, from the world’s most iconic financial services brands to advice firms of all sizes, banks, insurers, investment managers, traders and brokers. Iress is one of Australia’s largest technology companies and employs more than 2,500 people across Australia, The United Kingdom, Africa, Canada, France, New Zealand and Asia.

Build your career at Iress!

The Strategy Analyst is a key contributor to the development and execution of Iress’ Group strategy. Reporting to the Head of Group Strategy, with day-to-day alignment to the Strategic Planning and Engagement Manager, the role supports the delivery of high-priority strategic initiatives, often CEO/Board-mandated and cross-functional in nature, and plays an integral part in executing Iress’ core strategic processes.

This role is well-suited to an early-career professional with strong analytical capabilities, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for data-driven, high-impact strategy work. The Strategy Analyst will help shape and support the initiatives that underpin Iress’ long-term strategic goals.

Some of the awesome things you’ll be involved with:

Support For Strategic Projects

  • Provide hands-on support to the Group Strategy team on high-priority strategic initiatives, including Board-mandated and cross-functional projects.
  • Assist in coordinating workstreams, ensuring deliverables are aligned to project goals and stakeholder expectations.
  • Conduct analysis, prepare documentation, and support stakeholder engagement to enable successful delivery of key milestones.

Delivery Of Core Strategic Processes

  • Strategic Initiative Tracking and Management: Lead the central tracking and governance of high-value strategic initiatives, providing clear, consistent visibility to the Leadership Team and Board through a structured monthly process.
  • Strategic Planning Cycles: support the coordination and execution of the Annual and 5-Year Planning processes, ensuring effective cross-functional input and alignment. This includes contributing to data gathering, analysis, and preparation of the Iress Corporate Strategy.
  • Other Core Strategic Processes: Support the delivery of key strategic forums, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Strategic Councils, ensuring alignment, coordination, and effective execution across the organisation.

What You Will Bring

  • 2+ years' experience in a strategy function, preferably within a top-tier management consulting firm or an in-house strategy team.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with data, Excel-based models, and structured thinking approaches.
  • Ability to conduct market and competitor research, synthesise insights, and contribute to strategic recommendations.
  • Exposure to project-based work and able to break down problems, test hypotheses, and support strategic initiative delivery in a team setting.
  • Capable of producing clear and well-structured presentations and documents for an executive audience, using G-suite & Microsoft tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey ideas clearly to peers and managers.
  • Professional, collaborative, and proactive mindset, with a willingness to learn, take ownership of tasks, and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to juggle multiple priorities effectively.

Why work with us?

  • 8 additional paid days per year to extend your weekends
  • Hybrid working
  • Generous cash bonus for every successful referral
  • Starting school leave - 8.5 days of leave to assist your children with the transition to school
  • Up to 26 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary carers (up to 4 weeks for secondary carers), and the ability to work part-time when returning to work
  • 3 days’ paid leave per year to participate in charity initiatives
  • Discounted health insurance premiums
  • Gym membership discounts
  • Access to learning and development programs through LinkedIn Learning

Iress is committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive culture. We strongly believe that diversity is what makes our teams and our products succeed. Our people have different experiences, skills, perspectives and beliefs and everyone’s uniqueness is valued and celebrated.

Our hiring decisions are never based on sexual orientation, race, gender identity, religion, disability, citizenship, marital or family status and age. Even if you feel you don’t meet all of the requirements of the role, we would still like to hear from you!

We’re also proud to be globally recognised as a WORK180 Endorsed Employer that promotes and supports all women in the workplace.

  • For more information about what we do, our people and values, please visit our website - https://www.iress.com/join-us/careers/

Employee

Full time

json.title: Analyst, Treasury Settlements (12-month contract)
json.descriptionHtml:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

Job Responsibilities

  • Enter Treasury related transactions initiated by dealers into relevant internal/external systems, including Money Market, FX and Derivatives items.
  • Sort and distribute maturing corporate deals to dealers for instructions.
  • Confirm transactions and instructions with counterparties and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Check dealing evidence and SWIFT confirmations (MT320 / MT399).
  • Check and authorise STP deals, book transfers and trades in the external matching/settling system.
  • Release STP payment orders for Corporate and Interbank Money Market transactions.
  • Prepare customer notices, documents and confirmations for corporate customers for MM, FX or Derivative transactions.
  • Prepare SWIFT messages via SAMH and monitor confirmation matching.
  • Ensure timely and accurate payment/settlement of GMO products.
  • Ensure efficient settlement in Austraclear, RITS and NZClear.
  • Reconcile funds received and investigate unallocated or non-received funds.
  • Handle customer and internal enquiries and follow up outstanding items.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Cross-train to support other parts of the Operations team as required.
  • Prepare daily and monthly reports for Operations Management.
  • Perform end-of-day balancing and reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with risk management standards, policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain confidentiality of bank and customer information.
  • Observe Work Health & Safety requirements and undertake additional duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in Treasury Operations or a similar operational role within the banking or financial services industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook. Experience with VBA/Macros will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain a high level of accuracy when processing transactions.
  • Degree, diploma, or equivalent tertiary qualification preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing business requirements and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Ability to quickly acquire and apply knowledge of Treasury products, processes, and systems.
  • Sound technical aptitude with experience in transaction processing, settlements, reconciliations, or related operational activities.
  • A proactive team player with a strong risk and control mindset and commitment to operational excellence.

We regret to inform that only shortlisted applicants will be notified.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

json.title: Analyst - Energy Advisory
json.descriptionHtml:
For more than 20 years, KordaMentha has supported businesses through some of their most complex matters and opportunities. Founder owned and led; we are an advisory firm that helps corporations, financiers, lawyers, private investors and government clients to grow, protect and recover value.

That’s what we do, but it’s how we do this that makes us who we are.

Proudly independent, strategically local, and with a bias for action to get things done, we focus on doing what is right by our clients, our people, and the wider community. Our track record shows that we help navigate the best path forward in challenging times, and do so across cities, regions and territories.

In the most stressful or demanding environments, we continue to drive change where it really counts.


Job Description

Australia’s energy system is undergoing one of the most significant transitions in a generation. At KordaMentha, our Energy Advisory team helps clients move from intent to execution, supporting organisations across strategy, investment, regulation, operating models, technology, performance improvement and delivery.

We are looking for an Analyst to join our growing Energy Advisory team and work alongside experienced energy experts on practical, outcome-focused engagements across Australia’s changing energy market.

This is an opportunity to build your advisory career in a team that works with energy consumers, providers, infrastructure owners, government, regulators and adjacent critical infrastructure sectors. You will help clients navigate complex market dynamics, including growing energy demand, decarbonisation, decentralisation, energy infrastructure needs, policy and regulatory change, and emerging technology.

In this role, you will:

  • Support client engagements through research, analysis, problem solving and the preparation of high-quality reports, presentations and client deliverables.
  • Apply quantitative and qualitative analysis to help solve complex commercial, regulatory, operational and technology problems.
  • Research energy industry trends, market reform and emerging practice, while building depth in one or more energy domains.
  • Work directly with clients and stakeholders, building strong working relationships and contributing to practical outcomes.
  • Use tools, including AI, to improve the quality and efficiency of your work, with the judgement to review and validate outputs.
  • Support business development, proposals, marketing activities and industry engagement.



Qualifications

You will bring a strong interest in the energy and utilities sector, a curious mindset and the motivation to build your advisory career. You may have gained early experience in consulting, advisory, professional services, government, infrastructure or an in-house energy team, ideally with exposure to energy or broader infrastructure.

We are looking for someone who brings:

  • Around 1 year of relevant experience, or equivalent exposure, in energy, utilities, infrastructure, consulting, advisory, government or a related environment.
  • A developing understanding of one or more energy and utility sectors, such as generation, networks, retail, gas or water.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down information and identify key issues.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to contribute to team discussions and client deliverables.
  • Competency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with a willingness to continue developing these skills.
  • Strong attention to detail, initiative and the ability to manage tasks in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • A proactive, practical and solutions-focused mindset.
  • Empathy, integrity, curiosity, a willingness to learn quickly and openness to feedback.

You may not tick every box, and that’s okay. If you meet most of the criteria and are excited by the opportunity to build your advisory career while contributing to Australia’s energy transition, we would like to hear from you.


Additional Information

Join KordaMentha— Build your future, shape ours



We don’t just hire talent; we invest in it - with support that accelerates your success in every way

Why Join Us?

  • Professional Development: Expert mentorship, tailored training via KordaMentha Business School, study support, and our Accelerate program for Analysts to Associate Directors — build your brand, expand your network, and gain strategic insights from senior leaders
  • Flexibility: We champion work/life integration with options that fit your lifestyle.
  • Career Growth: Merit-based promotions, secondments, and opportunities to work alongside senior leaders on impactful projects.
  • Leave That Works for You: Buy extra leave and access volunteer, generous parental leave and career break options.
  • Culture & Connection:Social events, cultural celebrations, be part of our diversity and inclusion program, KMConnect.
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, return-to-work support through our partner GracePapers, and resources for every stage of family life.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Inclusive wellness initiatives and confidential and industry leading EAP for you and your family.

This isn’t just a job — it’s a place where your ambitions are nurtured, your wellbeing is valued, and your contributions celebrated. Ready to shape your future with us?

How to Apply:

Please submit your resume via our online portal.

Recruitment and Search Firms:

While your interest is appreciated, KordaMentha does not take responsibility or accept charges for unsolicited approaches.

At KordaMentha, we're at our best when different perspectives come together to solve complex problems. We believe better outcomes come from people with diverse experiences, backgrounds and ways of thinking.

We bring together the right teams to help our clients tackle complex challenges and move forward with confidence. That collaborative mindset is central to how we work. We foster an environment where ideas are welcomed, curiosity is encouraged and people are empowered to contribute from day one.

It's how we create opportunities and deliver outcomes that count for our clients, our people and the communities in which we operate.

If you're looking for meaningful work, real responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact, we'd like to hear from you.

json.descriptionHtml:
TAFE NSW Life-Changing Careers

Policy Analyst

Location negotiable across NSW (subject to campus availability)

Permanent Full Time

$131,911 – $142,056 salary package - includes base salary ($116,219 - $125,157), plus employer’s contribution to superannuation and annual leave loading


At TAFE NSW, we are dedicated to life-changing impact.


That’s why we offer world-class training and education that delivers the skills needed for the jobs of today and tomorrow.


Life-changing impact starts with an incredible team that sees their career as an opportunity to transform someone’s world. Whether that’s inspiring students, supporting each other, or helping our communities and industries flourish.


We live by TAFE NSW values: Customer Focus, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence. They define who we are, how we work, and inspire our performance.


We invest in our people


At TAFE NSW, you will discover a diverse, dynamic, and collaborative environment, where you can innovate, create value, and do meaningful work.

We provide you with tools, ongoing training and professional development, health and wellbeing programs, and a 35-hour working week with a variety of flexible working options.


About the role

Working within the Procurement Capability and Governance team, the Policy Analyst reviews procurement processes, systems, tools and policies to identify risks, compliance issues and opportunities for improvement. The role provides analysis, reporting and recommendations to support effective procurement practices and informed decision-making across TAFE NSW.

json.title: Risk & Compliance Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
Meet your team

The team is responsible for the day-to-day management, development and monitoring of the various risk, compliance and quality management functions within the firm and the provision of advice in respect to these functions. This includes administering, designing, implementing, supporting, training, monitoring and advising on risk management, compliance management, independence and quality management across all practice areas of the firm, as well as supporting Pitcher Partners Network Firms.



About the role
The role is best suited to someone with 1-3 years' experience in law, compliance, risk management and/or internal/external audit looking to build their skills in a non-client facing role. This role has a focus on the compliance functions for the broader firm. A recent graduate will also be considered.

This diverse role is an opportunity to be supported to develop your career within the risk and compliance space.



Key responsibilities

  • Maintaining and monitoring AFSL Obligations - including assisting with reporting obligations to ATO, ASIC, AUSTRAC and IRS as needed.
  • Assisting the Privacy Officer, Complaints Officer and Anti-Money Laundering/Counter-Terrorism Financing Officer in applying and maintaining associated policies and laws.
  • Supporting the firm's AML/CTF Program, including risk assessments and onboarding of customer and ongoing monitoring and due diligence.
  • Assist with maintaining the various registers such as AFSL breach register, data breach register, complaints register, Register of Benefits and Gifts.
  • Assist with maintenance of compliance and business templates to accommodate legislative changes, policy changes and risks including - Financial Services Guide, Target Market Determination, Representative Manual, Client Questionnaires, advice templates and engagement letters.
  • Assist with varying the AFSL licenses as and when applicable
  • Assist with developing and maintaining training plans for representatives in line with Financial Advisers and Planners Code of Ethics and RG146 requirements. This also includes monitoring training completed against these plans.
  • Assist with conducting internal reviews including undertaking file, banking and advisory reviews of investment advisory files, portfolios and processes and compliance with policies and procedures.
  • Assist with external independent audits including GS007, APES 310 and AFSL audits, along with the EOFY audit of investment prices.
  • Other general compliance and administrative functions such as assisting with the preparation of Investment Committee and Board packs and taking minutes (if and as required).
  • Assist in the identification and interpretation of legislative changes and / or policy changes and interpreting the impacts on the business. This includes developing strategies, training, policy and business templates under the direction of a manager, in response to the changes and communicating the same to relevant stakeholders, including Brisbane.
  • Additional compliance tasks as directed by the Chief Risk and Compliance Officer



Who we're after
Here are the key qualifications, skills and personal attributes we're looking for. If you tick most of the boxes, but not all, we'd still encourage you to apply. Other capabilities you have may make you the perfect fit for the role, and we can work on filling the gaps together.

Related tertiary qualifications
You have a commerce and/or law degree and/or have gained experience working in internal or external audit, accounting, compliance, risk management, legal services and/or financial services. We will also consider applications who are newer or returning to the workforce and have an aspiration to forge a career in risk and compliance.

Strategic thinker
Commercially minded, you think strategically and can work either autonomously or collaboratively in a team. You can interpret and apply legal and technical knowledge and can craft well written, accurate and practical communications or advice.

Effective time management
System savvy, you can prioritise tasks and effectively manage competing deadlines. You act with integrity and can influence and develop trusted working relationships with key stakeholders.

Location: Chatswood, NSW - Hybrid

Job Category: Insurance & Vets

At PetSure, we’re passionate about creating a world that’s better for pets and their people. As an Actuarial Analyst , you’ll help shape pricing, portfolio management and business performance through data analysis, forecasting and market insights.

Working closely with Pricing Actuaries, Machine learning and stakeholders across the business, you’ll analyse trends, monitor portfolio performance and provide data-driven recommendations that support sustainable growth and strong customer outcomes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their actuarial career who is looking to build capability in pricing, analytics and commercial decision-making.

What You’ll Do

  • Support pricing and portfolio management through data analysis and forecasting
  • Analyse claims, customer and market trends to identify opportunities and risks
  • Assist with pricing implementation, testing and monitoring activities
  • Develop and maintain reports, dashboards and performance insights
  • Apply statistical techniques and sound judgement to solve business problems
  • Build familiarity with the machine learning models feeding into pricing, and support their validation from an actuarial lens
  • Collaborate across teams to support business performance and strategic decision-making


What You’ll Bring

  • Tertiary qualifications in Actuarial Studies, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline with a strong mathematical foundation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Experience using Excel and SQL and other toolkits for analysis and reporting
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills

  • Work on meaningful challenges in a growing, purpose-driven business

json.title: Corporate Strategy & Financial Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
At Pet Circle, we believe pets deserve the very best, and the people who love them deserve a better way to care for them. Since 2011, we've grown from that single idea into Australia's biggest online pet retailer, with around 500 Pet Circlers across Australia, New Zealand and the Philippines, reshaping how pet parents discover, choose and receive what their pets need.

Pet care is a $15 billion industry in Australia, and as pet ownership continues to grow, so do the expectations of modern pet parents. They want expert advice, personalised experiences, convenience and reliability, all delivered seamlessly. That's where we come in. We're building the future of pet care through technology, innovation and a deep understanding of what pets and their people need. It's a big opportunity, and we're only just scratching the surface.

The role

This is a rare entry point into the commercial heart of a fast-growing business - ideal for a standout grad or an early-career professional ready to trade a structured firm environment for something with more pace and ownership.

What You’ll Be Working On

Board Reporting & Corporate Governance

  • Lead the operational roll-forward and administrative management of the Reporting templates, coordinating directly with financial systems and data platforms to extract baseline inputs.
  • Consolidate data and narratives from the broader finance function, and leadership to compile performance packs for leadership.

Strategic Planning Coordination & Timeline Management

  • Act as the central custodian of the corporate planning calendar. Track milestones, deliverable deadlines, and interdependencies for the annual planning process and rolling forecasts.
  • Attend key strategic forums to capture outputs, track core action items, and synthesise ideation notes into highly structured, actionable artefacts.
  • Maintain the ongoing development of integrated financial models used for budgeting and financial performance analysis, guaranteeing the integrity of data inputs.
  • Assist in executing both recurring and ad-hoc analyses on market, business trends, financial outcomes

What We're Looking For

Experience & Background

  • A high-achieving Finance or Accounting grad, or someone 1-2 years into consulting, corporate advisory or a Chartered firm who's ready for something with more pace and real business impact.
  • You've experienced (or are craving) an environment where priorities shift quickly and you adapt without losing the thread.
  • You're confident communicating with people at all levels - whether that's a data analyst, a cross-functional partner, or someone in the exec team.

Technical & Analytical Capabilities

  • Strong financial modelling and numerical skills, with the kind of attention to detail that catches things others miss.
  • Excel and PowerPoint are second nature. Exposure to BI tools (Looker Studio, Power BI) or Cloud ERP systems like NetSuite is a bonus.
  • You're good at taking messy inputs - a brain dump, a rambling meeting, raw data - and turning them into something clear and logical.

Core Competencies & Qualifications

  • Organised in a real way: you can juggle competing priorities and still know exactly where everything stands.
  • Commercially curious, proactive, and genuinely motivated to learn - not because it looks good, but because you actually want to understand how businesses work.
  • Bachelor's degree completed. If you're working toward a professional credential (CA, CPA, CFA), that's viewed favourably.

Where you'll work

This is a Sydney-based role. Our office sits on top of Wynyard station, it's pet-friendly (of course), and we work flexibly, a mix of office and home. We believe spending time together in person is important for building strong relationships, collaborating effectively, moving quickly as a team, and having fun!

A few good things

  • Heaps of development opportunities - lunch & learns, secondments & unlimited learning courses via Go1
  • Flexible working environment
  • Up to 50% employee discount
  • Product sample giveaways
  • Pawrental leave and wellbeing leave
  • Volunteer days for the causes you care about
  • Fitness corporate partnership

Why you'll want in

Looking after pets, and the pet parents who love them, is what gets us out of bed. That energy carries into how we work, and into what your days here would feel like.

You'll own your patch and have the room to act on it. We move fast and decide fast, and we'd rather test an idea and learn from it than sit on it. You'll have rich, real-time data at your fingertips to back your thinking, and the freedom to chase an opportunity the moment you spot one. The best idea wins, wherever it comes from.

What Holds It Together Is What We Stand For

  • We're better together
  • We operate with humble hearts and hungry minds
  • Pets matter, so pets and pet parents always have a seat at our table
  • We're instinctively curious. Always

Everyone (& their pets) Welcome

We're better when we don't all think the same. Different backgrounds, perspectives and experiences make our work sharper and our days more interesting, so whoever you are, if this role excites you we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't tick every box. And if you need anything adjusted in the process to do your best, just say the word, we're happy to help.

Our story, like many good ones, starts with a human and their dog. Our founder, Mike noticed his Dad struggling to lug heavy bags of dog food home from the pet store. And so, in 2011, Pet Circle was born in Sydney with a simple mission: to make caring for pets as easy as possible.

And we've come a long way. Today, we're the #1 player in the Aussie online pet industry and one of Australia's top 5 eCommerce businesses.

Company Description

At The Good Guys, we’re here to help families live better for less. Since 1952, we’ve been delighting customers with unbeatable deals and exceptional service and advice with their home appliances and consumer electronics.

We offer the best value, world-class brands and exceptional customer service across our 100+ store network, online, and in our commercial division, The Good Guys Commercial.

Great careers start at The Good Guys – begin your journey with us today.

Why join The Good Guys?

  • Fast paced and exciting environment where diversity is celebrated, and creativity and ideas are valued.
  • Competitive remuneration to recognise our team for their effort, which depending on the role, may include generous sales commission and other fantastic incentives to celebrate success.
  • Access to exciting career opportunities and comprehensive training and development programs as part of the broader JB Hi-Fi Group (which includes JB Hi-Fi Australia, JB Hi-Fi New Zealand, The Good Guys and E&S Trading).
  • Fantastic discounts across the JB Hi-Fi Group, plus access to Beny, our team member benefits app with exclusive offers, wellbeing perks and everyday savings.
  • We offer 12 weeks paid parental leave for eligible primary carers (and a gift for new parents) and we embrace flexibility and offer hybrid working models for eligible roles.
  • Our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provides counselling and wide array of other wellbeing resources for our team members and their families.
  • Our Helping Hands workplace giving program has raised millions for our charity partners to support positive impact in the community.
  • Demonstrating our commitment to sustainability, we are on track to reach our goal of net zero carbon emissions by 2030 and continue to improve the way we reduce, reuse, and recycle.

Job Description

As the Returns Analyst within the Customer Solutions -Post Sales Support team, you will be responsible for improving the Gold Service Extras program's efficiency and reduce claims costs by investigating charges, identifying and sharing process breakdowns and holding internal and external stakeholders to account where costs are not warranted.

Key Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To

  • Reconciling, analysing, and investigating all Gold Service Extra (GSE) repair and replacement costs to ensure costs are valid.
  • Seeking reversal of claims from vendors where their claim rejection is not warranted or unreasonable. This includes investigating case history where relevant, preparing and issuing appropriate communication to vendors and following up in a timely manner.
  • Seeking underwriter support where underwriter costs are incorrectly incurred by Gold Service Extras.
  • Where reversing a claim rejection is approved, supporting the processing of that reversal and where not approved report log and escalate as required to drive vendor or process improvement.
  • Identifying internal processing errors and ensure internal stakeholders are held to account, including where appropriate, recovery of costs incorrectly incurred by Gold Service Extras.
  • Where possible, identify and arrange reprocessing of cases and claims to avoid costs being incurred by Gold Service Extras incorrectly.
  • Identifying, investigating and seeking resolution to system or process errors that may result in avoidable Gold Service Extras costs. This includes Customer Experience, Reverse Logistics, Supply Chain, POS, CRM, and Accounts.
  • Collaborating with key stakeholders where system and process improvements may reduce systemic issues identified.
  • Preparing and presenting reporting to key stakeholders illustrating the sources of Gold Service Extras claim costs and achievements in reducing those costs.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Proficiency in financial and data analysis, including excel and other reporting tools.
  • Experience in reverse logistics and/or vendor management
  • Retail/Supply Chain experience, preferred

Additional Information

If you are interested in this exciting opportunity with us, please click apply and upload your CV. All applications are strictly confidential.

JB Hi-Fi Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a work environment that promotes diversity and inclusion. If this opportunity excites you (even if you feel that you don’t meet 100% of the criteria) – please don’t hesitate to apply!

json.title: Junior Demand Planner - ANZ - Melbourne
json.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for candidates at a Junior level, with experience of 0 - 4 years


Job Description


Position: Junior Demand Planner - ANZ


Position Reports to: Global Head – Supply and Demand Planning


Department: Supply Chain


Location: Melbourne, Australia


We Offer : The Salary Range for this role is 84,000 - 103,000 AUD


Position Summary:


We are seeking a proactive and analytically driven Junior Demand Planner to join our agile ANZ supply chain team.


This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and wants to make a real impact.


You will take ownership of demand planning across our sexual wellness portfolio, ensuring accurate forecasting to support service levels, inventory efficiency and commercial growth.

Working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Operations, you’ll be a critical link in aligning supply with demand in a business that values entrepreneurial thinking, accountability and smart collaboration.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Own the demand planning process for key SKUs and customer channels across ANZ.
  • Lead monthly forecast cycles, incorporating input from Sales, Marketing and Finance.
  • Track and reconcile demand signals vs. actuals; communicate variances and recommend corrective actions.
  • Partner with Supply and Inventory Planning teams to ensure product availability and optimal inventory.
  • Maintain forecast accuracy KPIs and support improvements in forecast performance.
  • Monitor trends, promotions, seasonality, and new product launches to inform demand plans.
  • Support S&OP processes by providing timely, data-driven insights and forecast inputs.
  • Collaborate with commercial teams on key customer and retailer planning.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in planning tools and reporting.
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate data analysis, generate insights, automate reporting, and support root-cause analysis of forecast variances


What You Will Do:


  • Deliver weekly and monthly forecasts and reporting packages
  • Analyze historical sales, POS data and promotions to build forward-looking plans
  • Engage closely with cross-functional teams to align assumptions and drive accountability
  • Highlight risk and opportunity scenarios for proactive inventory and supply response
  • Support the team with system clean-up, master data accuracy and planning optimization
  • Act as the forecasting lead for select product categories or customer segments.


Qualifications and Skills:


Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Economics, or related field
  • 0 –4 years of experience in demand planning, preferably in CPG / FMCG or consumer healthcare
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Experience with planning tools and ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Anaplan, Excel)
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
  • Comfortable working in a lean, hands-on environment with shifting priorities
  • Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini) for data analysis, automation, or research


Preferred

  • Experience in sexual wellness, lifestyle or personal care categories.
  • Familiarity with POS data analysis and retailer-specific forecasting
  • Understanding of S&OP or IBP processes.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a roll-up-your-sleeves approach

About the Company


LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia.


Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries.


The LifeStyles family of brands includes the #1 global non-latex condom brand, SKYN®, Owning a large portfolio of trademarks, LifeStyles manufactures and commercialises its products, under its local heroes such as Mates®, LifeStyles®, Manix®, Unimil®, and Blowtex® and Control. The brands values are centered around sex positivity, pleasure, confidence and inclusivity.


Outside of branded products, the Company also supports universities, NGOs, and other organizations as part of a broader effort to promote sexual health and prevent the spread of STDs and STIs. LifeStyles owns and operates manufacturing facilities in Thailand, India and Spain, and it employs over 1,600 teammates globally.


LifeStyles Healthcare was created on September 1, 2017, when the consortium of Humanwell Healthcare & CITIC Capital private equity purchased the Sexual Wellness division from Ansell.


As of December 1, 2022, Lifestyles is owned by Linden Capital Partners, a Chicago-based private equity firm focused on the healthcare industry.


This is an exciting time to join us. We combine century-long history with the opportunity of a new beginning as a stand-alone company - this means a new way of thinking, the opportunity to explore new horizons and the chance to make a mark in an exciting, fresh business.

LifeStyles Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.


We are empowered professionals, and we are committed to creating a team of the world’s “best of the best.” Our business foundation is strong, among our values are Integrity and Respect, our people are highly engaged. We have a focus on safety and teamwork - and we want you to join us! If you're looking for a daring opportunity to build brands in this booming & thrilling category, then let's talk.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.


Discover more about us at: https://www.linkedin.com/company/lifestyles-healthcare/.

json.title: Data Quality Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
Role Description

The Data Quality Analyst will support the accuracy, consistency, completeness, validity, and reliability of data across business systems, databases, reports, and operational processes. The role focuses on identifying data quality issues, investigating discrepancies, maintaining data standards, and supporting initiatives that improve the overall quality and usability of organizational information.

Key responsibilities include reviewing and validating datasets, identifying duplicate or incomplete records, detecting inconsistencies, and documenting data quality issues. The role will work with data from databases, spreadsheets, business applications, reporting platforms, and other approved sources.

The position will perform routine data quality checks based on established business rules and validation requirements. Responsibilities may include data profiling, reconciliation, format validation, completeness checks, duplicate detection, exception reporting, and monitoring data quality indicators.

The Data Quality Analyst will collaborate with data, technology, operations, finance, compliance, and business teams to investigate identified issues and determine potential root causes. The role may assist with data cleansing, remediation activities, process improvements, and the implementation of controls designed to prevent recurring data problems.

Additional responsibilities include maintaining data quality documentation, updating validation rules, tracking remediation activities, preparing data quality reports, and supporting data governance initiatives. The role may also contribute to defining data standards, business rules, quality thresholds, and procedures for maintaining reliable information.

The successful candidate should be analytical, detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with structured datasets and large volumes of information. Strong problem-solving abilities are important for investigating discrepancies and identifying relationships between data issues and underlying business processes.

The role also requires strong communication and collaboration skills, as the Data Quality Analyst will need to explain findings clearly, coordinate corrective actions, and work with different stakeholders to improve data processes and reporting reliability.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree, diploma, or equivalent qualification in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of data quality concepts, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, validity, uniqueness, and timeliness.
  • Familiarity with data validation, data profiling, data cleansing, reconciliation, and quality monitoring processes.
  • Basic to intermediate knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar spreadsheet and data-management tools.
  • Familiarity with data visualization and reporting platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent tools.
  • Understanding of databases, tables, fields, relationships, data structures, and common data formats.
  • Ability to identify missing, duplicated, inconsistent, inaccurate, or invalid information within datasets.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills with the ability to identify potential root causes of data quality issues.
  • Ability to develop, document, and execute data quality rules, validation checks, and control procedures.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing datasets, reports, records, and data-related documentation.
  • Ability to prepare data quality reports, dashboards, summaries, and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with data governance principles, metadata, data standards, and information management practices.
  • Understanding of data privacy, confidentiality, security, and responsible data-handling principles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain data issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple data issues and remediation activities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with data engineers, developers, analysts, business teams, and process owners.
  • Familiarity with Python, R, or other data analysis technologies is advantageous.
  • Proactive and detail-focused approach with a strong interest in improving data reliability, operational efficiency, and business decision-making.
