json.title: Data Quality Analyst / Junior Data Quality Analyst / Data Quality Specialist (Entry / Junior Level)
json.descriptionHtml:
Data Quality Analyst / Junior Data Quality Analyst / Data Quality Specialist (Entry / Junior Level)Role Description

We are seeking a precise, analytical, and process-driven Data Quality Analyst / Junior Data Quality Analyst / Data Quality Specialist (Entry / Junior Level) to safeguard the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of our enterprise data assets. In this foundational role, you will work closely with Data Engineers, Data Analysts, Database Administrators, and Business Intelligence teams to monitor, audit, and improve data quality across core pipelines and repositories. You will be responsible for defining data validation rules, detecting anomalies or corruption, conducting root-cause investigations on pipeline errors, and executing data remediation workflows. Responsibilities include running routine automated quality checks, auditing master data sets for duplicates or missing values, documenting data lineage and metadata catalogs, and assisting with data governance policies. Success in this position requires a keen eye for detail, strong SQL querying capabilities, basic scripting skills for data profiling, and a proactive commitment to ensuring high-quality data across all business operations.

Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Database & SQL Querying: Strong proficiency in writing basic-to-intermediate SQL queries (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, subqueries, and string manipulation) to profile, audit, and compare datasets across relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, or Snowflake).
  • Data Profiling & Quality Frameworks: Practical understanding of core data quality dimensions—accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and validity.
  • Data Cleaning & Scripting: Hands-on experience or coursework using Python (Pandas) or R for automated data cleaning, duplicate detection, pattern matching, and dataset validation.
  • Data Quality & ETL Tools: Exposure to dedicated data quality, profiling, or ETL validation tools (e.g., Great Expectations, Talend, Informatica Data Quality, or AWS Glue) is an advantage.
  • Spreadsheet Proficiency: Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, conditional formatting, and regular expressions) for rapid ad-hoc data profiling and discrepancy mapping.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Strong logical problem-solving ability to trace data errors back to source systems, API integrations, user input mistakes, or ETL transformation failures.
  • Data Governance & Metadata: Familiarity with basic data governance principles, metadata management, data dictionary maintenance, and master data management (MDM) concepts.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to articulate technical data issues, document validation rules, and collaborate with data engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Professional Attributes: Rigorous attention to detail, strong ethical standards regarding data handling, structured organizational habits, and a continuous focus on operational quality.

json.descriptionHtml:
Description

Do you want to make bold impacts with some of our largest and most visible Retail brands on Amazon? Are you a passionate, customer-obsessed leader with a desire to influence how we drive business growth? You may be a great fit for the Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) team!

AVS works directly with a selection of the most strategic Retail vendors (supplier partners) to improve the value, selection and convenience across their Amazon business. Our team creates and innovates across brands, processes and people to grow business results and improve Vendor engagement and satisfaction.

We are seeking highly motivated Brand Analysts, who will act as Strategic Account Managers, owning the client-facing relationship with these supply partners and serve in an e-commerce capacity to drive their success, including growing revenue, improving operational efficiencies, executing initiatives and driving traffic and conversion. In this role, you will influence building and executing joint business plans with your Vendor, and collaborating with them to explore innovative merchandising, operational, and selection improvement opportunities.

The ideal candidate for this role should possess strong analytical, account management and/or vendor management skills. They should be able to deliver on commitments, manage workflows in a fast-paced work environment and actively participate in contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. Above all, they should demonstrate a high level of ownership and ability to navigate ambiguity. If you are interested in growing Amazon’s top brands, then we’re interested in you!

Key job responsibilities

Available to start immediately, as a Graduate Brand Analyst you will gain experience and a wide range of responsibilities, including;

  • Identify, action, and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams.
  • Execute tactical support requests for Vendor, such as issue troubleshooting, data reporting, supply chain and catalogue management. Following up and escalating as appropriate to get these resolved in a timely manner.
  • Demonstrate excellent time-management skills and the ability to work independently while using centralized resources and procedures.
  • Build strong relationship with the Vendor; be a trusted advisor and the central contact for their issues, questions, requests, escalations, and concerns.
  • Liaise with other internal departments as necessary to resolve Vendor issues and questions quickly and with high quality.
  • Teach Vendors how to be more successful on Amazon through training them on Amazon tools and policies and educating them on relevant growth opportunities in Amazon’s ecosystem of products.
  • Collaborating and exploring innovative ways to identify and execute new product selection, brand management, promotional strategies, operational efficiencies and reporting analysis for your vendors.
  • Working with varied stakeholders across AVS and wider Amazon teams such as Vendor and Category Managers, Instock, Finance, Operations, Marketing to drive best possible outcomes for your strategic vendors and customers.
  • Leading planning and performance sessions with your strategic vendors, and act as their main point of contact at Amazon.

To Achieve Success In This Role, You Will Possess

  • A natural appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly
  • Strong analytical, relationship management and organizational skills
  • A focus on identifying problems and creating solutions!
  • Exceptional communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.
  • Drive to deliver results in an ambiguous environment, being exceptionally detail orientated while looking around corners and thinking bigger about how we create a compelling customer offer.

A day in the life

You will learn and use a wide range of skills working across major functional areas:

Vendor management: growing selection of products available to Amazon customers, driving traffic and conversion initiatives, promotion planning, identifying and resolving vendor-related issues

In-stock management: inventory planning and sales forecasting, tracking purchase orders through to delivery, managing inventory sell-through, working with vendors on PO automation

Content management: improving product detail page content, developing and executing marketing and merchandising plans, improving customer experience onsite

View more information and our Day in the Life of Brand Specialist videos here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fYaySG_trNY

What does my onboarding program look like?

The second week consists of an AVS Functional Training curriculum, where graduates gain technical experience required for the Brand Analyst role. The functional training week is structured around our key AVS pillars; Business Advice, Selection, Operational Excellence, Conversion and Traffic. AVS Academy is designed to develop our pipeline of future leaders, by exposing them to various learning and development opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

  • You must be in the final year of a university undergraduate or postgraduate degree, or have completed a tertiary qualification (undergraduate or postgraduate) in relevant field within the last 2-3 years. Please note: To be eligible for the 2026 Graduate Brand Analyst role you must be able commence the program by July 2026 having completed your studies.

  • 0-24 months prior experience in Consulting or Finance, managing multiple stakeholders or working in data analytics (Excel, SQL, Tableau). json.descriptionHtml:
Please Note: If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply directly to Kennedys or reach out to Kennedys' recruitment contact listed on our advert for a confidential conversation. We are not currently accepting applications from agencies for this position.

Kennedys is looking for a proactive and detail-focused New Business Risk Analyst to join our global New Business Risk team.

In this role, you will support the Firm's new business intake processes and provide information, guidance and practical support in relation to professional responsibility, conflicts of interest, compliance and the commercial considerations associated with accepting new business. You will work across a global platform while also supporting Risk & Compliance matters in Australia, Singapore and Hong Kong.

This is an excellent opportunity to develop your risk and compliance expertise within a growing international law firm with a diverse global practice.

The team

Kennedys' Risk & Compliance team operates as an in-house legal function, supporting the Firm with regulatory, professional conduct and compliance matters. Within this function, the New Business Risk team specialises in supporting the Firm's global new business intake processes.

You will work closely with colleagues across the global Risk & Compliance function, as well as stakeholders in Finance, HR, Facilities and Business Development.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist with the implementation of Intapp within the Risk & Compliance Department
  • Support the delivery of an effective and responsive new business risk process across the Firm
  • Conduct research using internal and external information sources
  • Undertake an initial review of conflict search results, identify potential issues and prepare conflict-of-interest reports for Legal Counsel, the General Counsel and requesting lawyers
  • Review conflicts and assist with opening new matters using Intapp and Elite 3E
  • Review new matters for compliance with relevant Anti-Money Laundering requirements
  • Provide practical advice and assistance to internal stakeholders on conflicts of interest and compliance matters
  • Recognise when an issue should be escalated to Legal Counsel, the General Counsel or the Head of New Business Risk
  • Support the General Counsel, APAC with the maintenance and management of the Risk & Compliance framework across the region, including global risk policies, compliance processes, training and reporting
  • Collaborate with teams across the Firm on cross-functional matters
  • Maintain a high standard of service for the Firm's internal clients and contribute to the continued development of the function's professional reputation


About You


We are looking for someone who is well organised, proactive and comfortable working with detailed and confidential information in a fast-paced global environment. Given the global nature of the role, flexibility to work around different time zones is essential.

Other Skills And Attributes Required Are


  • Previous experience using Intapp or Elite 3E within a professional services environment would be advantageous but is not essential, as training will be provided
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving abilities
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure and meet deadlines
  • Confidence providing timely guidance within a busy international organisation
  • The ability to develop positive and professional relationships with stakeholders at all levels
  • Sound judgement and the ability to maintain trust and confidentiality
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365
  • Exposure to Anti-Money Laundering requirements would also be beneficial


A relevant tertiary qualification is preferred. We also welcome applicants with an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

CLOSING DATE: 31st August


*Where a level of experience is indicated, this is a guideline only and represents the amount of time we would usually expect a candidate to accumulate the requisite level of experience. This does not preclude applications from candidates with more or less experience.

Please let us know if you require any additional support or adjustments to be made in order to submit your application to Kennedys.

json.title: Entry Level Project Planner
json.descriptionHtml:
About TBH

At TBH, we dream of transforming communities and improving lives, by providing innovative solutions to our clients most complex problems.


We’re one of Australia’s largest privately owned, independent consultancy with an international footprint, and have been specialising in high-risk, large-scale and challenging projects since 1965.

As leaders in our field and trusted advisors, we have provided specialist project management services to the public and private sectors on over 8,000 landmark projects across Asia-Pacific and the Middle East.


TBH has been growing rapidly in Australia and internationally, but continues to be a connected, collaborative and supportive team. We have set our strategy looking ahead to 2030, to ensure we continue to meet the needs of clients and set ourselves up as a business for the future.


About the Opportunity

Our Canberra team is looking forward to welcoming an Entry Level Project Planner (Analyst) with a foundation of knowledge in construction management, and an interest in developing their career in project planning.. As our Analyst you'll step into a dynamic entry-level consulting role offering hands-on experience across major projects and the opportunity to learn from some of the industry’s best.


This is your chance to discover an alternative career in a consulting environment where no two days are the same. TBH specialises in a broad range of project management services including planning and scheduling, project controls, cost management, claims and dispute resolution, and risk management. This gives you exposure to in-depth project experiences across a wide range of industries, projects and challenges both within Australia and internationally.


You’ll play a key role in supporting senior consultants and project teams with research, data analysis and the preparation of client deliverables. With structured guidance and mentorship from experienced professionals, you’ll build a strong foundation in project controls, scheduling and consulting.


Bring your fresh ideas and passion for learning to TBH, where our collaborative environment and expert support will help you thrive. From day one, you’ll work closely with experienced consultants and senior leaders across our Eastern Region team and the wider TBH network, contributing meaningfully while gaining valuable hands-on experience.


As our Analyst you’ll be responsible for:

  • Supporting project plan implementation and contributing to delivery under guidance from senior team members
  • Researching, reviewing and analysing project data to support reporting and deliverables
  • Preparing high-quality documentation including reports, schedules and presentations
  • Applying project controls methodologies to identify issues and support solution development
  • Collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders to support effective project delivery
  • Supporting process improvements and assisting with general business administration as required


What you’ll bring

As our successful candidate you'll bring;

  • A relevant Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field
  • Some exposure to project scheduling or project controls
  • Exposure and foundational knowledge in construction management
  • Exposure to project management software like Microsoft Project or Primavera P6
  • Experience using Microsoft applications and software (desirable).
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to support report preparation
  • Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and work in a collaborative environment
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach with a willingness to learn and develop capability
  • Professional, reliable and client-focused attitude
  • Curiosity, initiative and a proactive mindset toward learning and improvement


Why work at TBH

At TBH, we are ACHIEVEMENT and outcome focused, operating with aligned strategic intent and delivering on our promises to ensure optimum results for our clients. Additionally, our ONE TEAM culture drives us to operate with one way of working that fosters care and collaboration.


Through our strong values, TBH is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can feel comfortable to be their full selves at work. We value people from different backgrounds and all walks-of-life as we believe our collective experience inspires blue-sky thinking and creative solutions.


As a proud WORK180 Endorsed Employer for Women, we believe in gender equality and equal opportunity. You can view more about our company’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://work180.com/en-au/for-women/employer/tracey-brunstrom-hammond-tbh


What TBH can offer you

Along with a competitive salary plus bonus, and limitless opportunity to progress your career and passions with us, TBH also offers employees:

  • Flexible working - we understand employees may need to adjust their working arrangements for personal reasons or to “work from anywhere” for a fixed or indefinite period.
  • Inclusive culture - at TBH, we’re committed to fostering an environment where all individuals feel valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.
  • Parental leave - we provide 16 weeks of parental leave for primary carers, and 3 weeks of parental leave for secondary carer.
  • Career development - employees are supported with their career development through on-the-job training and mentorship, in-house training programs and financial support for approved industry institutions and associations.
  • Health & wellbeing - all employees have access to our Employee Assistance Program, Telus Health, an independent, confidential service to help you to improve your health and wellbeing, resolve challenges and reach your goals. Annual flu vaccinations are also offered by TBH.
  • Social events - a range of social events and company-sponsored sporting events take place throughout the year to help employees build connections with others across the organisation.
  • Reward and recognition - TBH employees are recognised for their contributions through our Award programs, remuneration packages and promotion opportunities.

json.descriptionHtml:
We’re BDO, a global professional services firm connected to local markets. Our people work together to provide specialist expertise, helping businesses achieve their goals.

We inspire others, to go further. We create together, to reach higher. We build trust, to lead purposefully.

Whether you're building your future or starting your career with us, you won’t do it alone. From creating solutions for our clients to building careers for our people, we shape what matters, and that’s where you come in.

About The Role

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be involved in valuations (infrastructure assets, accounting, tax and other regulatory valuations, derivatives etc.), due diligence assignments (acquisition and vendor due diligence, other vendor assistance) and a variety of other corporate finance engagements.

BDO’s Deal Advisory team promotes a collaborative environment where our team members are encouraged to participate in a diverse range of deal advisory engagements, spanning corporate finance, valuation, due diligence, financial modelling and mergers and acquisitions. At BDO, exceptional client service underpins our belief system and all aspects of service delivery to our clients. There are continuous opportunities to learn, build strong relationships with diverse client groups and expand networks nationally and globally at all stages of your career.

Key Duties And Responsibilities

  • Analyse financial statements, market data, and industry trends to determine valuation inputs
  • Prepare detailed valuation reports and presentations for clients
  • Using research facilities to identify comparable companies and calculate relevant valuation metrics (including normalisation adjustments, as appropriate)
  • Constructing, reviewing and amending complex financial models
  • Applying valuation methodologies including discounted cash flow, capitalised maintainable earnings and option pricing models
  • Assisting with transaction management, including populating and maintaining data rooms
  • Communicating with clients and other transaction advisors to progress engagements

About You

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills that enable results to be communicated concisely
  • Solid analytical and research skills
  • Strong work ethic, interpersonal skills, and passion for adding value
  • 1+ years of experience in a professional services firm (in an area such as deal

advisory/corporate finance) or a relevant commercial role

  • CA or CPA qualified and/or financial modelling background considered advantageous
  • Experience working alongside and dealing with solicitors, directors, banks, and creditors

Competitive salary based on level of experience: starting from $80,000 inclusive of super

Why BDO?

Working for BDO you will be part of a growing and market leading professional services firm.

Our national and global footprint provides our people with opportunities to work on interesting client engagements, across diverse industry sectors and services.

Our open and collaborative culture ensures access to Partners and professional mentors, to guide and accelerate your professional career, across a wide array of career pathways.

We provide our people with various health and wellbeing, social, financial, and professional development benefits to help realise what’s possible.

Participate in fitness challenges or take advantage of exclusive discounts to corporate health insurance, gym memberships and wellness facilities via our BWell program. Access benefits such as travel perks, retail discounts, employee referral rewards, study, and professional development support.

Our leave options cater to the unique needs of our people; and include enhanced family support, cultural and religious leave, and options to purchase additional leave. You can also give back and get involved in community initiatives via our BCaring program.

With a strong focus on learning and growth, we provide on the job training and formal development programs to help you succeed in your role and develop your skills and experience.

Our culture is underpinned by our core values (One, Bold, Human, Heart and Strive).

We are proud to be recognised as an Inclusive Employer for 2025-2026 by Diversity Council of Australia and a 2024-2025 Employer of Choice for Gender Equality by the Workplace Gender Equality Agency (WGEA).

BDO is committed to inclusive and accessible recruitment practices. If you require any reasonable adjustments to support your application or interview process, we encourage you to contact our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@bdo.com.au

json.title: Junior Operations Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
A great opportunity as Junior Operations Analyst with a growing and dynamic business, based within the [axr] marketing team, giving you hands-on exposure to data, software and process improvement, with the added benefit of your work having visibility across the wider business, alongside real, practical involvement in podcast editing, events and administration.


  • Junior Operations Analyst role based within the marketing team, combining data, software and process improvement with hands-on support across campaigns, podcast editing and events
  • Ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys data, tools and systems, to build practical experience in reporting and process improvement, with scope to contribute to ways of working that benefit the wider business
  • Exposure to campaign data and reporting, the marketing tools and systems behind it, business administration, and the operational side of podcast editing and event delivery


About the Role

The Junior Operations Analyst plays a key role within the [axr] marketing team, keeping campaigns, reporting and processes accurate and running smoothly, using the systems and tools that support the team day-to-day, while also getting hands-on with the practical side of podcast editing, events and business administration. As you build your skills, there's scope to contribute process improvement thinking that benefits the wider business.


This role suits a motivated, detail-focused individual at the early stage of their career who's genuinely interested in data, software and process, and is just as comfortable rolling up their sleeves for the day-to-day tasks that keep a marketing team moving. You'll gain exposure to reporting, campaign tracking, marketing systems and tools, process improvement, podcast editing, event support and business administration, building a strong foundation in operations, with the potential to grow that impact across the business over time.


Key Responsibilities

Data, Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Help maintain marketing systems and tools, and keep reporting accurate, consistent and up to date, including tracking job postings and campaign performance. You'll get comfortable working with data and software day-to-day, and have the chance to spot smarter, more efficient ways to track and report, with scope for this thinking to extend to the wider business over time.


Campaigns & Content

  • Support the setup and delivery of email marketing campaigns, including tracking and reporting on performance. Assist with content creation across blogs, whitepapers and social channels, helping turn ideas and source material into clear, on-brand copy.


Podcasts

  • Edit and publish podcasts, write accompanying copy and create supporting social assets, then share episodes across all channels.


Events, Administration & Team Support

  • Assist with the planning and delivery of [axr] events, and provide administrative support and general enquiry handling for the wider team. Work closely with marketing and internal stakeholders to support day-to-day activities, and contribute to a collaborative, supportive team environment.


Ideal Background

  • A strong interest in data, software and process improvement, alongside marketing, communications or digital media.
  • Comfortable working with numbers, tools and detail, with a genuine curiosity for how a marketing team, and the wider business, operates day-to-day.
  • A relevant qualification in business, marketing, communications or a related field is desirable.
  • Strong attention to detail with good organisational skills.
  • Confident written and verbal communication skills.
  • A positive attitude with a willingness to learn and develop, including learning new systems and software.


Please apply, or reach out to Brieanne Foster - brieannef@axr.com.au

json.title: Relationship Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
At Rabobank, our commitment to our employees and clients is at the heart of everything we do. As the world’s leading specialist in food and agribusiness banking, one of our key strengths lies in our people who have a deep understanding of agriculture and are committed to adding long-term value for clients.

Our culture is unique, because every day our people work knowing that we are all playing our part in supporting our farmers to feed the world. We strive to create an open, balanced, and flexible workplace where people feel that they belong, can be open and honest and are supported…we are focused on growing each other.

About The Role

We have an opportunity for a Relationship Analyst to join our Dubbo branch. This role provides valuable prudential and client relationship support to Account Managers (Rural and Branch Managers) to enable them to develop new business, manage existing client accounts and to enable our clients to reach their goals and aspirations.

You will be responsible for acting as an additional formal point of contact for client, client advisors, oversight of journey from client request to settlement, responsible for initiating all associated branch prudential management tasks, comprehensive Compliance Due Diligence (CDD) risk analysis in Anti-Money Laundering/Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF), Know Your Client (KYC) requirements and other associated day to day operational tasks.

Some of the key responsibilities include:

  • Actively engage in preparation of loan applications
  • Interpret and execute branch prudential management tasks
  • Monitor loan arrears and accounts in excess to take appropriate action from a commercial and prudential perspective
  • Develop and foster strong working relationships with all key stakeholders

To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Knowledge of the rural industry will be advantageous
  • Client focused with a positive attitude
  • Works effectively through team collaboration
  • Articulate with strong verbal and written skills
  • Strong analytical skills

What we're proud to offer you:

Wellbeing leave. These leave days support greater work/life balance and is just another way we are helping our employees to lead happier, healthier, and more fulfilling lives.

Education Assistance Program. Rabobank values the development of its people and has a great Education Assistance Program to assist with professional development.

Parental Leave that supports you and your family while giving you the freedom and flexibility to enjoy this special time (up-to 14 weeks paid leave)

Bonus and Additional Leave. We realise sometimes 4 weeks Annual Leave isn't enough! At Rabobank we provide an incentive for eligible employees to receive 1 extra week Annual Leave and an option to purchase another 2 weeks Annual Leave.

Extra Insurance. Rabobank recognises that employees need to protect their financial wellbeing, in the event of serious illness, injury, or even death. Rabobank provides eligible permanent employees with employer-funded Death, TPD and Income Protection Insurance.

Rabo Workplace Giving program. As part of Rabobank's global Corporate Social Responsibility, Workplace Giving aims to encourage employees to contribute to our community. Rabo Workplace Giving program matches employee donations to selected Social Partners.

Our Values:

Rabobank Australia values inclusion, belonging, and positive experiences for all. Our work environment, our benefits, and the way we live our values, “Client Driven”, “Responsible”, “Professional” and “Cooperative” make it a great place to work. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds.

Please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any accommodations to make our opportunities more accessible to you.

Rabobank is not accepting submissions from recruitment agencies for this role.

Applicants must hold valid work rights for this role.

json.location: St Leonards, New South Wales, Australia
json.descriptionHtml:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Analyst, Account Management

The Australia market serves as a good platform to drive incremental business for Mastercard through new opportunities in card portfolio optimisation, loyalty, digital as well as other Mastercard services and expanding into new networks. The role will work with the account management team and all relevant functional teams to achieve the market objectives in these areas through the identified deliverables below.

Major Accountabilities

  • Actively manage the account sales pipelines for the customer set
  • Conduct research & analysis to support business strategies and customer e.g., Issuer customer growth plans, customer business reviews and internal regular management reporting.
  • Use analytical and problem-solving skills to provide analyses and insights for customers or internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in, and sometimes lead, projects focused on customer needs, customer event management or internal improvement.
  • Work collaboratively across multiple internal teams to support a variety of business initiatives.
  • Problem solves where necessary to achieve optimal outcomes for our customer set. This role provides a breath of learning through end to end & cross functional exposure within Mastercard and with our customers.


Key Components Of This Will Be

  • Understanding how we make money, our pricing and profitability levers.
  • Understanding the Australian cards market and issuer needs
  • Understanding cards/banking loyalty
  • Partnering deep into our customer organisations to understand their needs, help them solve problems and help present as a strong team to win negotiations and gain market share.
  • Performing analysis and telling a meaningful story using data and information
  • Must be able to multitask and juggle multiple priorities
  • Must be focused on delivering on priorities.
  • Building relationships internally and with our customers


All About You

  • We are seeking a dynamic individual with strong analytical abilities, a proactive mindset, and a track record of successfully delivering on responsibilities.
  • You’ll be capable of working effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Be able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and possess excellent multitasking skills.
  • High level of proficiency in advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint is essential, along with intermediate to advanced data manipulation capabilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and exceptional verbal and written communication skills are a must. You should also demonstrate strong emotional intelligence (EQ) and possess exceptional relationship-building skills.
  • A genuine enthusiasm for continually expanding their knowledge of new digital payments technology is highly desirable.
  • Previous experience in cards issuing and/or banking loyalty programs would be an asset but not essential.


This is more than just a role; it's an opportunity to gain end-to-end exposure across one of the world's leading payments companies. If you're looking to accelerate your career, develop new skills, and make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced environment, apply via the links below.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

json.title: Analyst - Independent Valuation Control
json.descriptionHtml:
Our team in Finance, People and Engagement supports independent valuation processes for trading portfolios. We work closely with teams across the business to ensure valuations are accurate, consistent and aligned with regulatory and internal standards.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

In this role you will support independent valuation reviews across a range of financial instruments, helping ensure portfolios are valued accurately using market data and appropriate methods. You will analyse market movements, prepare clear reports, and work with stakeholders across trading, risk and finance to resolve differences and improve processes. Your work helps maintain strong financial control in a dynamic environment.

What You Offer

  • A degree in finance, accounting, economics or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills with high attention to detail and a structured approach to problem-solving
  • A basic understanding of financial markets and products such as derivatives, commodities, bonds and equities
  • Good skills in Microsoft Excel, with exposure to tools such as Power BI, VBA or Python being beneficial
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

What We Offer

Benefits

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on employment type, include:

  • 1 wellbeing leave day per year
  • Up to 5 additional service bonus leave days per year
  • Up to 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of transition leave upon return to work, and 6 weeks’ paid leave for non-primary caregivers
  • 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
  • Up to 12 months’ gender affirmation leave, including 6 weeks’ paid leave
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing benefits including skin and health checks, and flu vaccinations
  • Access to a wide range of salary packaging options
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
  • Reimbursement for work from home equipment

About Financial Management, People and Engagement

Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.

Inclusion at Macquarie

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.

json.descriptionHtml:
💼 Financial Analyst (Hybrid, Entry-Level)

Location: Australia 🇦🇺

Employment Type: Full-time / Part-time

🌟 About the Role

We’re looking for a motivated, analytical, and detail-oriented Entry-Level Financial Analyst to join our finance team 😊

In this role, you’ll support financial analysis, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and data-driven decision-making. You’ll work closely with finance and business teams to analyse financial information, identify trends, prepare reports, and provide insights that support business performance. This is a great opportunity for graduates and early-career professionals to build practical financial analysis experience 🚀

🛠 Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with financial analysis, reporting, budgeting, and forecasting 📊
  • Collect, organise, validate, and analyse financial and business data
  • Prepare financial reports, dashboards, presentations, and management summaries
  • Analyse revenue, expenses, profitability, and business performance
  • Assist with monthly and quarterly financial reporting activities
  • Perform variance analysis and investigate differences between actual and forecast results 🔍
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes
  • Maintain accurate financial models, spreadsheets, and supporting documentation
  • Assist with cash-flow analysis and financial performance monitoring
  • Work with finance and business teams to gather and validate financial information
  • Identify trends and provide insights to support business decisions
  • Assist with ad hoc financial analysis and business projects
  • Present financial findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy when handling financial information 🔐

✅ What We’re Looking For

  • Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
  • Good understanding of accounting and financial principles
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills
  • Ability to analyse data and communicate findings clearly
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organisational and time-management abilities
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn 🌱
  • Genuine interest in developing a career in finance and financial analysis

🎓 Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Commerce, Data Analytics, or a related field (preferred)
  • Recent graduates and entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply 🌟
  • Previous internship, academic project, finance, accounting, or data-analysis experience is a plus
  • Familiarity with Excel, Power BI, SQL, financial modelling, or reporting tools is advantageous
  • Basic understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis is preferred
  • Knowledge of Australian accounting and business practices is an advantage

  • Hybrid working arrangements 🏡
  • Entry-level opportunity with hands-on financial analysis experience
  • Supportive and collaborative finance team 😊
  • Mentorship, training, and professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to budgeting, forecasting, reporting, financial modelling, and business performance analysis
  • Opportunity to develop valuable analytical, technical, and commercial skills
  • Clear pathway for professional growth within finance and business analytics 🚀

json.title: Entry Level Project Planner
json.descriptionHtml:
About TBH

At TBH, we dream of transforming communities and improving lives, by providing innovative solutions to our clients most complex problems.


We’re one of Australia’s largest privately owned, independent consultancy with an international footprint, and have been specialising in high-risk, large-scale and challenging projects since 1965.

As leaders in our field and trusted advisors, we have provided specialist project management services to the public and private sectors on over 8,000 landmark projects across Asia-Pacific and the Middle East.


TBH has been growing rapidly in Australia and internationally, but continues to be a connected, collaborative and supportive team. We have set our strategy looking ahead to 2030, to ensure we continue to meet the needs of clients and set ourselves up as a business for the future.


About the Opportunity

Our Sydney team is looking forward to welcoming an Analyst, where you’ll step into a dynamic entry-level consulting role offering hands-on experience across major projects and the opportunity to learn from some of the industry’s best.


This is your chance to discover an alternative career in a consulting environment where no two days are the same. TBH specialises in a broad range of project management services including strategic advisory, planning and scheduling, project controls, cost management, claims and dispute resolution, and risk management. This gives you exposure to in-depth project experiences across a wide range of industries, projects and challenges both within Australia and internationally.


You’ll play a key role in supporting our senior consultants and project teams with research, data analysis and the preparation of client deliverables. With structured guidance and mentorship from experienced professionals, you’ll build a strong foundation in planning & scheduling, strategic advisory and consulting.


Bring your fresh ideas and passion for learning to TBH, where our collaborative environment and expert support will help you thrive. From day one, you’ll work closely with experienced consultants and senior leaders across our Sydney team and the wider TBH network, contributing meaningfully while gaining valuable hands-on experience.


As an Analyst you’ll be responsible for:

  • Researching, reviewing and analysing project data to support reporting and deliverables
  • Preparing high-quality documentation including reports, schedules and presentations
  • Applying project controls methodologies to identify issues and support solution development
  • Collaborating with internal teams and external stakeholders to support effective project delivery
  • Supporting process improvements and assisting with general business administration as required


What you’ll bring

As our successful candidate you'll bring;

  • A relevant Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Project Management, Quantity Surveying, Architecture, Engineering, Business/Commerce or a related field
  • Experience using Microsoft applications and software (desirable).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to support report preparation
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and work in a collaborative environment
  • A collaborative, team-oriented approach with a willingness to learn and develop capability
  • Professional, reliable and client-focused attitude
  • Curiosity, initiative and a proactive mindset toward learning and improvement
  • Proficiency in Japanese is desirable but not required


Why work at TBH

At TBH, we are ACHIEVEMENT and outcome focused, operating with aligned strategic intent and delivering on our promises to ensure optimum results for our clients. Additionally, our ONE TEAM culture drives us to operate with one way of working that fosters care and collaboration.


Through our strong values, TBH is committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can feel comfortable to be their full selves at work. We value people from different backgrounds and all walks-of-life as we believe our collective experience inspires blue-sky thinking and creative solutions.


As a proud WORK180 Endorsed Employer for Women, we believe in gender equality and equal opportunity. You can view more about our company’s commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://work180.com/en-au/for-women/employer/tracey-brunstrom-hammond-tbh


What TBH can offer you

Along with a competitive salary plus bonus, and limitless opportunity to progress your career and passions with us, TBH also offers employees:

  • Flexible working - we understand employees may need to adjust their working arrangements for personal reasons or to “work from anywhere” for a fixed or indefinite period.
  • Inclusive culture - at TBH, we’re committed to fostering an environment where all individuals feel valued, respected, and empowered to thrive.
  • Parental leave - we provide 16 weeks of parental leave for primary carers, and 3 weeks of parental leave for secondary carer.
  • Career development - employees are supported with their career development through on-the-job training and mentorship, in-house training programs and financial support for approved industry institutions and associations.
  • Health & wellbeing - all employees have access to our Employee Assistance Program, Telus Health, an independent, confidential service to help you to improve your health and wellbeing, resolve challenges and reach your goals. Annual flu vaccinations are also offered by TBH.
  • Social events - a range of social events and company-sponsored sporting events take place throughout the year to help employees build connections with others across the organisation.
  • Reward and recognition - TBH employees are recognised for their contributions through our Award programs, remuneration packages and promotion opportunities.

json.title: Customer Experience Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
About Stake

We’re an Australian investing platform that helps ambitious people confidently grow their wealth. By offering seamless, immersive access to ASX and Wall St, we’ve empowered a new wave of investors. Today, we have 750,000+ customers and more than A$8B under administration. Join us as we continue to reshape the financial industry, inspire investor confidence and unleash the investor in everyone.

About the role

We are looking for a Customer Experience Analyst to join our Customer Experience team in Sydney.

Customer Experience sits at the heart of the Stake experience. You’ll be one of the first people our customers turn to, helping them navigate everything from accounts and funding to trading and platform features with confidence. You’ll build a deep understanding of our products and customers, solve problems with clarity and make every interaction count.

This role goes beyond answering questions. You’ll spot patterns, uncover friction and work across Product, Operations and Engineering to make Stake simpler and better. You’ll have room to take ownership, contribute to projects and turn customer insight into meaningful improvements. We work hybrid spending 3 days in our beautiful, dog-friendly Sydney office.

What success looks like

Over your first two years, you’ll grow from a trusted customer problem-solver into someone who actively shapes how we deliver an exceptional Stake experience.

  • You’ll become a go-to expert on Stake’s products, features and processes, giving customers accurate, clear and useful answers across tickets, email and phone
  • You’ll own customer problems through to resolution, navigating more complex account, trading, deposit and withdrawal enquiries with sound judgement
  • You’ll build strong customer understanding, looking beyond the immediate question to uncover what people need and where we can make their experience simpler
  • You’ll identify recurring pain points and turn customer conversations into actionable insights for Customer Experience, Product, Operations and Engineering
  • You’ll help improve the way we work, simplifying processes, strengthening internal knowledge and creating useful customer-facing content
  • You’ll develop strong judgement around risk and compliance, protecting customers and Stake while delivering an experience that feels clear and considered
  • You’ll contribute beyond the day-to-day through projects, customer research, beta testing and bug hunting that improve our products and processes
  • You’ll raise the bar for Customer Experience through the quality of your work, your follow-through and the way you contribute to a high-performing team
You’ll thrive here if…
  • You’ve built strong customer service or support foundations, ideally with 1+ years’ experience in financial services, fintech or another customer-focused environment
  • You’re a clear, thoughtful communicator who can make complex information easy to understand across written and verbal channels
  • You’re a natural problem-solver. You’re curious enough to investigate what’s really happening and take ownership until there’s a clear outcome

json.title: Credit Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
At Rabobank, our commitment to our employees and clients is at the heart of everything we do.

As the world’s leading specialist in food and agribusiness banking, one of our key strengths lies in our people who have a deep understanding of agriculture and are committed to adding long-term value for clients.

Our culture is unique, because every day our people work knowing that we are all playing our part in supporting our farmers to feed the world. We strive to create an open, balanced, and flexible workplace where people feel that they belong, can be open and honest and are supported…we are focused on growing each other.

About the role:

Credit Analysts are responsible for providing valuable support to Account Managers to ensure commercial and prudential requirements are met for their portfolio of agribusiness customers. This includes financial analysis and credit writing for moderately complex agribusiness submissions working with stakeholders to meet client expectations.

This is a fast pace, varied role where no two days are the same and each submission is different and unique. We are looking for someone that enjoys communicating and building relationships with both internal stakeholders and external clients.

There is sufficient scope in this role to challenge an experience credit analyst as well as developing an emerging analyst – as such graduates or recent graduates are also encouraged to apply.

Some of the Key Responsibilities include:

  • Collaborating and dealing with Account Managers via the phone to deliver client outcomes
  • Analysing and interpret financial statements, identifying industry trends
  • Engaging in preparation of loan applications
  • Evaluating credit risks and make recommendations regarding client’s business proposals
  • Developing and fostering strong working relationships with all key stakeholders

To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Interested/experience within food and agribusiness
  • Client focused with a positive attitude
  • Strong with numbers and analysis
  • Works effectively through team collaboration
  • Articulate with strong verbal and written skills

What we're proud to offer you:

Wellbeing leave. These 2 extra leave days support greater work/life balance and is just another way we are helping our employees to lead happier, healthier, and more fulfilling lives.

Education Assistance Program. Rabobank values the development of its people and has a great Education Assistance Program to assist with professional development.

Parental Leave that supports you and your family while giving you the freedom and flexibility to enjoy this special time (Primary carer up-to 14 weeks paid leave)

Bonus and Additional Leave. We realise sometimes 4 weeks Annual Leave isn't enough! At Rabobank we provide an incentive for eligible employees to receive 1 extra week Annual Leave and an option to purchase another 2 weeks Annual Leave.

Extra Insurance. Rabobank recognises that employees need to protect their financial wellbeing, in the event of serious illness, injury, or even death. Rabobank provides eligible permanent employees with employer-funded Death, TPD and Income Protection Insurance.

Rabo Workplace Giving program. As part of Rabobank's global Corporate Social Responsibility, Workplace Giving aims to encourage employees to contribute to our community. Rabo Workplace Giving program matches employee donations to selected Social Partners.

Our Values:

Rabobank Australia values inclusion, belonging, and positive experiences for all. Our work environment, our benefits, and the way we live our values, “Client Driven”, “Responsible”, “Professional” and “Cooperative” make it a great place to work. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds. Please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any accommodations to make our opportunities more accessible to you.

Rabobank is not accepting submissions from recruitment agencies for this role.

You must hold valid work rights to be considered for this role.

json.title: Officer, FX Settlement
json.descriptionHtml:
Join Citi's Global Markets Operations team as an FX Settlement Analyst, where you will play a key role in the accurate and timely settlement of foreign exchange transactions on behalf of one of the world's leading financial institutions. Working within a structured and collaborative operations environment, you will support the end-to-end lifecycle of FX trades — from confirmation through to settlement and reconciliation — contributing directly to the integrity of Citi's transaction processing function.

Responsibilities

  • Verify FX trade bookings to confirm accuracy before settlement, identifying and resolving discrepancies at the point of entry.
  • Generate and match trade confirmations against International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) templates to ensure contractual alignment between counterparties.
  • Complete daily settlement tasks and rate revaluations within defined deadlines, maintaining operational accuracy across the trade lifecycle.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to resolve transaction processing issues efficiently and deliver timely solutions.
  • Perform account reconciliations, regulatory controls, and record retention activities in line with established operational policies.
  • Prepare and submit periodic internal and external regulatory reports, supporting Citi's compliance and reporting obligations.
  • Participate in General Ledger proofing exercises, ensuring financial records reflect accurate and up-to-date settlement data.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • Understanding of Treasury products, accounting principles, and regulatory frameworks relevant to financial markets operations.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks accurately in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.
  • Working knowledge of macros to support operational efficiency and data processing tasks.
  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across teams.

Beneficial Skills & Qualifications

  • Prior exposure to FX settlement, trade matching, or trade confirmation processes within a financial services environment.
  • Familiarity with securities or derivatives operations, including post-trade workflows.
  • Experience working within operations teams that support trading desks or transaction services functions.

What We Offer

At Citi, we offer a stable and structured working environment within a globally connected team, giving you the foundation to build a meaningful career in financial markets operations. As an FX Settlement Analyst, you will gain hands-on experience across the full FX trade lifecycle, supported by a team that values precision, collaboration, and continuous development.

  • Hybrid working arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, providing a consistent and predictable weekly structure.
  • Defined working hours from 8am to 5:30pm, supporting a stable and manageable work-life balance.
  • Exposure to global FX markets and cross-functional operations teams, broadening your understanding of financial markets infrastructure.
  • A clear entry point into Global Markets Operations at Citi, with opportunities to develop expertise and progress within the function.
  • No professional licensing requirements, allowing you to focus fully on building operational skills and domain knowledge from day one.
  • Access to Citi's global learning and development resources, supporting your professional growth within the firm.

Apply today to start your career in FX operations at Citi, where your attention to detail and commitment to accuracy will directly support the seamless settlement of global financial transactions.

json.title: Tendering Analyst
json.descriptionHtml:
About Zembl

Zembl saves businesses time and improves their bottom line. Our long, strong industry relationships help businesses buy better energy. We have local experts who’ll pick up the phone, have a chat and understand customer needs to take the legwork out of admin. Our simple digital platform and helpful people make admin easy, even pleasurable.

Purpose of the role

As a Tendering Analyst, you'll play a critical role in delivering accurate, competitive energy tenders that help our customers make better commercial decisions.

Working closely with our Energy Consultants, retailer partners and internal stakeholders, you'll manage the tendering process from initial request through to contract completion. From validating customer data and analysing retailer pricing to preparing tender documentation, you'll ensure every tender is delivered accurately, efficiently and to high standards.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate commercial energy tenders from initial request through to contract completion.
  • Validate customer and site information to ensure every tender is accurate before submission.
  • Prepare and issue Requests for Proposal (RFPs) through our tendering platform.
  • Analyse retailer pricing and prepare tender comparison reports for our Energy Consultants.
  • Produce accurate contract documentation and ensure compliance with internal policies and SLAs.
  • Build strong relationships with retailers, metering partners and internal stakeholders to keep tenders progressing.
  • Maintain accurate records across Salesforce and other internal systems.
  • Support bill validation, network tariff reviews and other commercial analysis activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, accuracy and efficiency.

What You'll Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy working with numbers, have exceptional attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You'll also bring:

  • 1–3 years' experience in an analytical, operations or administration role, or be a recent graduate in Commerce, Business, Economics or a related discipline.
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills.
  • A methodical approach with exceptional attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with a range of stakeholders.
  • A curious mindset with a desire to continuously learn and improve.

Experience within the energy industry is preffered, but certainly not essential.

Why join Zembl?

At Zembl, you'll be trusted to own your work, encouraged to challenge the status quo and supported to keep learning as you grow your career. We're a collaborative team that moves quickly, celebrates success together and is always looking for better ways of doing things

You'll also enjoy:

  • Hybrid work model, including the ability to work overseas for up to 20 days each year.
  • Ongoing coaching, development and clear career progression.
  • Earn additional annual leave through team incentives and years of service.
  • Long-term career opportunities within one of Australia’s fastest-growing energy businesses.
  • Free daily coffee and monthly Uber Eats office lunches

But don’t just believe us. Check out our ratings on Product Review where we have an average of 4.8 stars from 1600+ ratings!

Company Description

Nine is Australia’s largest locally owned media company. Working at Nine, you’ll have access to a unique range of experiences and opportunities, helping drive the success of the country’s most trusted television, radio, digital and publishing brands.

Our content reaches almost every Australian - meaning what we do has real impact. We bring people together, celebrate the big moments, and capture the everyday ones.

Some of our most beloved brands have been part of Australian life for generations, and others - new on the scene - have already found their place firmly in our lives. We’re evolving and we need people like you to bring new ideas, innovate and make your mark.

Job Description

Nine has an exciting opportunity for a Pricing Analyst to join our team!

Working closely with the Pricing Manager and Yield & Inventory teams, you will leverage key audience insights and commercial data to maximise revenue across Nine’s Total TV portfolio. You will build sophisticated models, optimise trading dynamics, and directly influence strategic commercial decisions across major sport and general entertainment products.

Day To Day You Will

  • Support the Pricing Manager in establishing, maintaining, and executing commercial pricing strategies across all Total TV channels.
  • Analyse key audience insights to form data-driven foundations for pricing recommendations.
  • Partner with the Yield and Inventory team to evaluate real-time supply and demand dynamics.
  • Build and maintain detailed commercial models to validate pricing across sports and general entertainment content.
  • Deliver regular reporting on market demand and audience trends to ensure strategy alignment.
  • Develop and maintain key internal pricing tools, such as Saturn and TVMap templates.
  • Serve as a collaborative contact for agency stakeholders and support the sales team’s understanding of trading dynamics.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring:

  • Strong financial acumen accompanied by exceptional analytical skills.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Outstanding time management skills with a proven ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong relationship-building skills to engage effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Prior experience in a media-related environment (desirable, but not essential).
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Research, Statistics, or a related discipline (desirable, but not essential).

Additional Information

How we work

At Nine, our flexible work options vary by role and team. Depending on the position, this may include flexible hours, hybrid work, or part-time arrangements. We welcome discussing your flexibility needs during the hiring process - just ask the Talent Acquisition team.

Our Employee Benefits Include

  • 18 weeks paid parental leave with no distinction between primary and secondary carers
  • Access to 'Employee Exclusives' program - a way of getting closer to our incredible brands, offering unique experiences, behind-the-scenes access, and awesome perks.
  • Digital newspaper subscription to our mastheads
  • Annual gift voucher for Stan subscription
  • More info at Nine Careers

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to a safe, respectful and inclusive Nine. From day one, you'll be encouraged to bring your whole self to work and will be supported to perform at your best.

We encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disabilities, and of all ages, genders, nationalities, backgrounds and cultures as we recognise the importance and value of diverse perspectives. Should you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please advise us when you apply.

Work rights: Please note to apply for this role you must already have the right to lawfully work and live in Australia.
